title: EasyNotification
description: Allows you to customize the Join and Quit message! Even with Color!
body:
# EasyNotification


This Plugin allow you to fully customize the join and quit message!
You can change the message via config.yml file or via command.
EasyNotification offers full [chat color code](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/minecraft-color-codes/) support. Also placeholders are supported. You can change the position of the playername as you wish.

## Placeholders
> ```
> {playername}
> ```
>  Put this at the position where the playername is supposed to be displayed

## Commands
> ```
> /setjoin   <Prefix>
> 
> /setleave  <Prefix>
> ```

## Config
> The config file is in /plugins/EasyNotification/config.yml.
> You can edit the file in any texteditor to your desires
